notes:
POC summary + decision criteria (shorthand):
- Customer: B2B mid-market analytics SaaS, product teams embed semantic search into UI and nightly ranking pipelines.
- Data volume: ~1.2M documents today, expected 3x in 12 months. Typical doc length skewed: 60% short (50-300 tokens), 40% long (1-15k tokens).
- Ingestion patterns: nightly batch (~500k embeddings), realtime upserts during day (~300-500/s bursts). Need efficient batch pipeline + low-cost vector storage.
- Target latency: interactive search <120ms p50, p95 <250ms; background batch throughput must finish within 4 hours for nightly window.
- Cost sensitivity: high for embeddings; want mix of open models + quantized variants. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to hit cost targets.
- Model preference: open weights preferred (Llama-derivative, Mistral-like), but will consider Redwood-verified variants. Want fallback routing when cheapest model exceeds quality threshold.
- Vector DB: currently piloting Pinecone; evaluating Weaviate and Elastic as fallback. Want Redwood to integrate easily with existing vector DBs and support direct KV/cache to reduce queries.
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO (SAML) for team; KMS integration and audit logs mandatory. Some EU customers -> need data residency options (ask: can Hosted API restrict storage region?).
- Key quotes from product lead: "Batch job cost is our #1 worry — if embeddings blow up infra costs we can't ship search widely."
- POC success criteria (customer-defined): ingest 100k docs, run nightly batch in <4 hours, kNN p50<100ms at 500 QPS, semantic recall > baseline Elastic search on defined eval set.
- Technical notes from SE: observed ingestion CPU-bound on our batch runner; try continuous batching + prefix cache for popular queries. Also suggested using Redwood's recommended quantization profile for 8-bit embeddings.
- Commercial ask: sample Dedicated pricing for 3 node reserved pool (guaranteed 500 QPS) + burst to 2k for 1 hour. Need clarity on commit terms and overage pricing.
- Legal: DPA review started; asked for a template and confirmation of EU data residency lanes.
- Next calls: POC wrap (Arielle/Devon) 2026-03-17; pricing deep-dive w/finance 2026-03-24.
- Internal: chase infra team for a demo script that stresses nightly batch path; prepare comparison matrix (hosted per-token vs Dedicated reserved cost)
